Test-admin creates a separate fresh isolated session with setup.faults.audit_failures equal to integer 1; 201 echoes the supplied session_id. Setup does not execute a test or fail an ordinary session. Refused capability is fail, not skip.

In the dedicated fault session, accept a valid clean fixture with normal 202 IDs, then observe PROCESSING_FAILED with completedAt, empty findings, TEST_AUDIT_FAILURE and exact specified test-only error details. Verify failed report checksPerformed empty and unchanged downloadable source. This is a required deliberately exercised case, not conditional observation.
A manual re-audit of the same accepted version runs normally after one injected failure. Other sessions are unaffected; the historical failed audit/report remains unchanged.
System report returns this session's code coverage (counts and basis, or paired nulls). 200 status and SystemReport evaluated.
202 UploadResponse with fresh IDs and PROCESSING.
Exact reviewed finding tuples and limitations for all six categories, correctly sorted and hashed.
New clean_all_six upload accepted; completed audit has AUDIT_COMPLETE and zero findings.
All-manual fixture audit completes REVIEW_REQUIRED, with no advertised APPLY correction.
Formal table with headerRowCount 1 or omitted and distinct matching labels produces no TABLE_HEADER finding.
Safe formal table with headerRowCount 0 produces one REQUIRES_USER_INPUT at actual tableId target.
Formal table with a blank header produces one MANUAL_REVIEW; no label is generated.
Casefold/trim duplicate formal header labels produce one MANUAL_REVIEW.
Formula header is MANUAL_REVIEW; cached text does not authorize editing the formula.
Dense 2x2-or-larger unstructured candidate with safe first-row labels requires explicit header-row input.
Nondense connected candidate is MANUAL_REVIEW with a limitation; disconnected regions are not joined.
Single row, single column, and isolated title do not produce inferred-table findings; scope limitation is present.
Hidden-sheet tables are inspected using the same criteria.
Each populated merge produces one MANUAL_REVIEW at #merge= rectangle; title merges included.
Empty and formatting-only merges produce no MERGED_CELLS finding.
Finite vocabulary, whitespace collapse, casefold, and one trailing punctuation mark follow Section 7.6.
http/https/www/mailto labels and exact-destination labels trigger; descriptive text does not.
Actual cell text determines the label; a misleading display attribute alone does not mask an ambiguous cell.
One/two literal HYPERLINK arguments are screened, but any correction remains MANUAL_REVIEW.
Computed/localized/unsupported HYPERLINK forms produce MANUAL_REVIEW and a limitation without evaluation.
Multi-cell and duplicate link representations are MANUAL_REVIEW with distinct indexed locations.
Default black/white and a neutral high-contrast pair produce no COLOR_CONTRAST finding.
Low-contrast static pair produces one cell MANUAL_REVIEW; no automatic recoloring.
18pt ordinary and 14pt bold text use 3.0; smaller text uses 4.5.
Use unrounded ratio for comparison; include vectors immediately above and below both thresholds.

Theme indices, HSL tint, and channel rounding match the frozen policy vectors. Use the corrected pack 2.1.1 constants, including both 336699 corrections and the 010101/050505 half-boundary cases. Exact half-channel values round upward despite intermediate numerical error; expectations must not be generated by the production color helper.
Explicit workbook palette overrides the standard 64-entry indexed palette.
Nonneutral color at adequate contrast still yields one manual color-meaning finding.
Visual conditional-formatting ranges get manual findings; static results inside them are suppressed.
Gradient/pattern/rich text/ambiguous inheritance/table overlay causes disclosure and manual review, not a guessed ratio.
Hidden cells use the same policy and deterministic locations.
ReviewResponse matches source current values, canonical item order and owner actions; no unknown fields are injected into Finding. Missing alt fields are null and existing values preserved.

Authorized source download equals uploaded bytes, not a regenerated workbook; correct media type and disposition.

All four supported edit families apply in deterministic source-target order, including rename on a sheet containing another selected target.
A hyperlink label starting with = is an explicit inline string, never a new formula.
